title: Elden Ring Smithing Stone 8 Locations: Where to Find and Buy Them
description: Find Smithing Stone 8 locations in Elden Ring, where to buy them infinitely, which Bell Bearing unlocks them, and how many you need for +24.
body:
Smithing Stone [8] is the final regular Smithing Stone tier before the Ancient Dragon upgrade. It takes standard weapons from +21 to +24, with 2 stones needed for +22, 4 for +23 and 6 for +24.

The easiest unlimited source is the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold. Defeat the Godskin Duo in Crumbling Farum Azula, give the Husks Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [4], and they will sell Smithing Stone [8] for 3,600 runes each.

If you only need a few stones before unlocking the shop, you can also loot Smithing Stone [8] in late-game areas including Crumbling Farum Azula, the Consecrated Snowfield and Yelough Anix Tunnel.
author: Rouane Mounssif
imageAlt: Elden Ring map of Crumbling Farum Azula marked with multiple Smithing Stone 8 pickup locations.
imageCredit: Screenshot: SegmentNext / Bandai Namco Entertainment / FromSoftware.

contentBlocks.text:
The best long-term source is the **Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold**. Once you give them **Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [4]**, their shop adds an unlimited supply of both Smithing Stone [7] and Smithing Stone [8].

Smithing Stone [8] costs **3,600 runes each**, so a complete set of 12 for one weapon's +22 through +24 upgrades costs 43,200 runes.

The Bell Bearing unlock also carries into New Game Plus, so once this shop stock is liberated you do not need to unlock it again in the next journey.
contentBlocks.heading: Where to buy Smithing Stone 8

contentBlocks.text:
**Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [4] drops from the Godskin Duo in Crumbling Farum Azula.** The boss is on the main progression route through the area, so you cannot permanently miss the Bell Bearing in a normal playthrough.

The quickest sequence is:

1. Progress through the Mountaintops of the Giants and reach **Crumbling Farum Azula**.
2. Continue through the legacy dungeon to the **Dragon Temple**.
3. Defeat the **Godskin Duo**.
4. Collect **Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [4]**.
5. Return to **Roundtable Hold** and give it to the **Twin Maiden Husks**.
6. Buy Smithing Stone [8] whenever you need more.

If your immediate goal is simply to finish upgrading one weapon, you can still collect loose Smithing Stone [8] pickups before or around this point without waiting for the unlimited shop.
contentBlocks.heading: How to get Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing 4

contentBlocks.text:
You do not have to wait for the Bell Bearing if you only need a handful of stones.

### Crumbling Farum Azula

Crumbling Farum Azula contains multiple Smithing Stone [8] pickups, including one available very early in the area and several more throughout the dungeon. Because the Godskin Duo also drops the Bell Bearing that unlocks unlimited purchases, Farum Azula is where Smithing Stone [8] usually stops being scarce.

### Yelough Anix Tunnel

**Yelough Anix Tunnel** in the Consecrated Snowfield is one of the best places to gather several Smithing Stone [8] items at once. The tunnel contains multiple pickups, and its miner enemies can also drop Smithing Stone [8].

### Consecrated Snowfield

Additional Smithing Stone [8] pickups are scattered around the **Consecrated Snowfield**, including the area around Yelough Anix Ruins.

### Caelid

There is also a Smithing Stone [8] in **Caelid near the Church of the Plague**. A nearby Spiritspring can be used to reach the rock formation holding the item.

These loose pickups are most useful when you want one or two more upgrade steps before you have unlocked the Twin Maiden Husks' unlimited supply.
contentBlocks.caption: Yelough Anix Tunnel contains several Smithing Stone [8] pickups and is one of the strongest places to collect the material directly. Screenshot: GameWith; Elden Ring © Bandai Namco Entertainment / FromSoftware.
contentBlocks.heading: Best Smithing Stone 8 locations before buying them
contentBlocks.imageAlt: A Smithing Stone 8 pickup glows inside the icy Yelough Anix Tunnel in Elden Ring.

contentBlocks.text:
A standard weapon needs **12 Smithing Stone [8] items** to move through the entire final regular-stone tier:

| Upgrade | Smithing Stone [8] needed |
| --- | ---: |
| +21 → +22 | 2 |
| +22 → +23 | 4 |
| +23 → +24 | 6 |
| **Total** | **12** |

After +24, the final +25 upgrade requires **one Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone** instead.

If you are still deciding which weapon deserves those materials, Neural Critic's [Elden Ring early-game progression guide](/stories/elden-ring-early-progression-what-to-upgrade-first/) explains why it is usually better to strengthen a setup you already understand than spread materials across everything you find.
contentBlocks.caption: A standard weapon needs 12 Smithing Stone [8] items to cover the +22, +23 and +24 upgrade steps. Neural Critic gameplay screenshot.
contentBlocks.heading: How many Smithing Stone 8 do you need?
contentBlocks.imageAlt: The Elden Ring blacksmith menu shows a standard weapon upgrade and the Smithing Stone materials required.

contentBlocks.text:
Yes. Miner enemies in **Yelough Anix Tunnel** can drop Smithing Stone [8], giving you a repeatable enemy-based source.

In practice, farming becomes unnecessary once you have Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [4]. The Twin Maiden Husks' unlimited stock is faster and more predictable if you are upgrading several weapons.

If you are short on runes, use the loose world pickups first and save the unlimited shop for the remaining stones you need.
contentBlocks.heading: Can you farm Smithing Stone 8?

contentBlocks.text:
Smithing Stone [8] only works on weapons that use the **standard Smithing Stone upgrade path**.

Unique and special armaments that use **Somber Smithing Stones** follow a separate +1 to +10 progression. If the upgrade screen asks for Somber Smithing Stone [9], regular Smithing Stone [8] cannot substitute for it.

If that is the material you need, use Neural Critic's [Somber Smithing Stone 9 locations guide](/stories/elden-ring-somber-smithing-stone-9-locations/). For the broader systems around weapon upgrades, leveling and exploration, start with our [Elden Ring beginner's guide](/stories/elden-ring-beginners-guide/).
contentBlocks.heading: Smithing Stone 8 does not upgrade Somber weapons

quickRead: Smithing Stone [8] upgrades standard weapons from +21 to +24; you need 12 stones for all three upgrade steps.
Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [4] drops from the Godskin Duo in Crumbling Farum Azula and unlocks unlimited Smithing Stone [7] and [8] purchases.
Twin Maiden Husks sell Smithing Stone [8] for 3,600 runes each after you hand over the Bell Bearing.
conclusion:
If you need only one or two Smithing Stone [8] items, Crumbling Farum Azula, Yelough Anix Tunnel and the Consecrated Snowfield all provide useful pickups. If you are upgrading several standard weapons, defeating the Godskin Duo and unlocking the Twin Maiden Husks' unlimited stock is the cleanest solution.

For one complete weapon tier, plan on 12 Smithing Stone [8] items before the final Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone upgrade to +25.
